第一卷 败落的岳家第四章 筑基初期

第四章筑基初期片刻之后，岳诚露出一丝微笑，原本还担心无法修练，因为原来的岳诚连斗气和魔法都无法修练，没想到这具躯体对于真气却没有任何的排斥，岳诚已经隐隐感觉到顺着混元真经的心法，丹田内已经出现了一丝微弱的真气，这真是修练成功的迹象。

第二天一早，岳诚停止了修练，长长的呼出了一口浊气，缓缓的睁开双眼，经过一夜的修练，双眼中已经有着两缕微微的精光，整个人的精神也好了很多。

“没想到进步还挺快的，看来七天就能进入筑基初期了。”岳诚喃喃道，有着超级的修为境界，修练起来的速度大大的超过了他原来的预算，一般人要想从普通人进入筑基期，最好的修练天赋也要半年的时间，自己却一晚上的时间就在丹田中凝聚起了一团真气，这样的速度简直可以用飞剑来形容。

“咚咚”房间外传进来一阵轻微的敲门声，随即一道低沉的声音在门外道：“诚儿，你醒了没有。”

“醒了，父亲你进来吧。”岳诚微微回答道，随即散开双脚躺在了床上。听声音他已经知道是谁，竟然已经决定自己以后就是岳诚，那么岳诚的一切他自然要全盘接受。在记忆中，他也知道自己这个父亲对自己疼爱之极，为了整个岳家，四十多岁的年纪看起来已经像是五十多岁的模样了。

“嘎吱”一道灰色的身影缓缓的走了进来，随即带上房门走到了岳诚的床边。

看着眼前的岳子山，岳诚不禁心中微微有些触动。看的出来就这几天的时间，岳子山就像是突然间老了十岁一样，原本乌黑的头发现在两鬓已经出现了白发，脸色也看起来苍白了不少。

“诚儿，你感觉怎么样了，昨晚听欣儿说你醒了，太晚我就没过来，好些了吗。”岳子山微微的看着岳诚，眼神中有着欣慰，也有着心疼。

“父亲，我没事了。”一时之间岳诚也不知道说什么好，看到岳子山的眼神，他仿佛回到了华夏千年前，那是自己才四岁的时候，父亲也是用这种眼神看着自己的，之后父亲就被人杀了，从此之后，他就进入了残酷无情的修正界，再也没有享受过父爱。

“没事就好，以后千万别再傻了，你要是出了什么事情，我怎么对得起你死去的母亲。”岳子山道。

“我不会再做傻事了。”岳诚微微回道，看着眼前的岳子山，他确实是一个伟大的父亲。

“一切都怪我没用，才会出现退婚这种事情，诚儿，你是不是很怪父亲。”岳子山突然沧桑的看着岳诚，要是自己能进入斗王的境界，也不会出现这种事情了。

“是我自己没用罢了，这不怪你。”岳诚微微的摇了摇头，事情的经过他已经全部了解。自己的未婚妻加入了鼎鼎大名的青阳门，十六岁的小小年纪就进入了斗灵的境界。因为自己不能修练斗气和魔法，基本上是一个废人，再加上岳家一天比一天败落的地位，所以对方便提出了要退婚的要求。

听着儿子的回答，岳子山不禁又心疼了几分，一个男的竟然被女方退婚，这简直就是莫大的欺辱，传出去的话哪还有脸做人，这也难怪诚儿会选择死这条路。

“别想太多，活着就好，活着的话你总会有机会的。”岳子山看着儿子微微道，看起来诚儿是想通了。

岳诚看着岳子山的模样，想说些什么，却一时张不开嘴。心中却暗道：岳诚，我既然已经拥有了你的躯体和记忆，那么有机会的话我一定会帮你取回公道，也会帮岳家做些什么，就当是报答你的躯体，不会让你白死的。

七天后，岳诚的房间内有着一丝丝淡淡的青芒，片刻，房间内的青芒缓缓的被岳诚吸入了体内。随即岳诚长长的呼出了一口浊气，两缕精光在眼中一闪而过，整个人的气息也在顷刻间发生了一丝微妙的变化。

“终于进入筑基初期了。”岳诚喃喃道，经过七天的修练，终于顺利的进入了筑基初期，有着超强的境界支撑，任何的修练关卡对岳诚现在来说都只是时间的问题。

“也该出去走走，看看这个陌生的世界了。”岳诚收拾一番走下床来，七天的时间自己还没出过房门，这几天也只有苏欣儿和冯嫂来看过自己，并端来了不少好吃的。

“小少爷好。”岳诚走出房门，一些佣人看到岳诚都高兴的问好，岳诚也是微微的对着众人点了点头。

岳家虽然败落了，但是在立英镇内也还算是有头有脸的，岳家大宅就坐落在立英镇的镇尾，整个岳家现在不加佣人也有着三四十口的人，只是不少的岳家族人都不在岳家，年轻一代的基本都出去闯荡了，就比如说岳诚的两个亲哥哥在十五岁的时候就离开了岳家出外闯荡，现在已经都七八年了。

岳家还有岳诚的一个叔叔和表姑，其他的都是岳家的第二代族人，像岳诚这样的岳家第二代族人大部分都在外闯荡，剩下的一些则是在帮忙打理着岳家的生意。

岳诚慢慢的在岳家大宅中走着，岳家大宅看起来还算过得去，光是房间就有着近百间，再加上祠堂和其它的一些建筑，岳诚走了半天才走了一遍。

“我得去看看这里能不能找到炼丹和炼制法器的材料。”岳诚在心底喃喃道，也不知道玄天大陆上有没有自己炼丹和炼制法器的材料，要是没有的话，还真是麻烦大了，修为一定会大打折扣的。

心中一想，岳诚也不再迟疑，连忙就要去岳家的商铺里去看看，在记忆中岳诚得知，岳家好像就有一些商铺是买卖药材的和兵器的，也不知道这些材料能不能适合自己用。

“表哥，你要去哪里？”岳诚刚走到岳家大宅的门口，苏欣儿的声音就在岳诚的身后传来，随即就走到了岳诚的身前。

今天苏欣儿穿着一件青色的长裙，一头乌黑的秀发高高的梳着发髻盘在脑后，大眼小嘴，胸前一对柔软的地方如山峦般耸立，纤细的蛮腰盈盈不足一握，翘臀浑圆结实，一双玉腿高挑修长，看起来女人味十足。

Volume 1: The Decline of the Yue Family Chapter 4: Early Stage of Foundation Establishment

Chapter 4: The initial stage of foundation building. A moment later, Yue Cheng showed a smile. He was originally worried that he would not be able to practice, because the original Yue Cheng could not even practice fighting qi and magic. Unexpectedly, this body did not reject the true qi at all. Yue Cheng had already faintly felt that following the mental method of the Hunyuan Sutra, a faint trace of true qi had appeared in his Dantian. This was really a sign of successful practice.

Early the next morning, Yue Cheng stopped practicing, exhaled a long breath, and slowly opened his eyes. After a night of practice, there were already two faint rays of light in his eyes, and his overall spirit was much better.

"I didn't expect the progress to be quite fast. It seems that I can enter the early stage of foundation building in seven days." Yue Cheng murmured. He has a super level of cultivation, and the speed of practice greatly exceeded his original budget. For ordinary people to enter the foundation building stage from ordinary people, it would take half a year for the best training talent. However, he had gathered a ball of true energy in his dantian in one night. This speed can be described as a flying sword.

"Dong dong" A slight knock on the door came from outside the room, and then a deep voice said outside the door: "Cheng'er, are you awake?"

"Wake up, father, please come in." Yue Cheng replied slightly, then spread his legs and lay on the bed.He already knew who it was by listening to the voice, and he had actually decided that he would be Yue Cheng from now on, so naturally he would accept everything about Yue Cheng.In his memory, he also knew that his father loved him extremely, and for the sake of the entire Yue family, he already looked like he was in his fifties when he was in his forties.

"Creak" A gray figure walked in slowly, then closed the door and walked to Yue Cheng's bedside.

Looking at Yue Zishan in front of him, Yue Cheng couldn't help but feel a little touched in his heart.It can be seen that in just these few days, Yue Zishan seems to have suddenly aged ten years. His originally black hair has now turned white on his temples, and his face looks much paler.

"Cheng'er, how are you feeling? I heard from Xin'er last night that you woke up and I didn't come over because it was too late. Are you feeling better?" Yue Zishan looked at Yue Cheng slightly, with relief and distress in his eyes.

"Father, I'm fine." Yue Cheng didn't know what to say for a moment. Seeing the look in Yue Zishan's eyes, he seemed to have returned to China thousands of years ago. When he was only four years old, his father also looked at him with this look. After that, his father was killed. From then on, he entered the cruel and merciless correctional world and never enjoyed his father's love again.

"As long as it's okay, don't be stupid again in the future. If something happens to you, how can I be worthy of your dead mother?" Yue Zishan said.

"I won't do stupid things again." Yue Cheng replied slightly, looking at Yue Zishan in front of him, he was indeed a great father.

"It's all my fault that I broke off the engagement. Cheng'er, don't you blame your father?" Yue Zishan suddenly looked at Yue Cheng with vicissitudes of life. If he could enter the realm of Dou Wang, this kind of thing would not happen.

"It's just me who is useless. It's not your fault." Yue Cheng shook his head slightly. He already understood everything that happened.His fiancée joined the famous Qingyang Sect and entered the realm of spirit fighting at the young age of sixteen.Because he could not practice fighting spirit and magic, he was basically a useless person, and the Yue family's status was declining day by day, so he made a request to break off the engagement.

Listening to his son's answer, Yue Zishan couldn't help but feel a little sad. A man had his engagement broken off by his wife. This was simply a huge insult. If word got out, he wouldn't have the dignity to behave. It's no wonder that Cheng'er would choose to die.

"Don't think too much, just live. If you live, you will always have a chance." Yue Zishan looked at his son and said slightly. It seemed that Cheng'er had figured it out.

Yue Cheng looked at Yue Zishan's appearance and wanted to say something, but couldn't open his mouth for a while.But I thought secretly in my heart: Yue Cheng, since I already have your body and memory, then if I have the chance, I will definitely help you get justice, and I will also do something to help the Yue family. I will treat it as repaying you with my body, and I will not let you die in vain.

Seven days later, there was a faint green light in Yue Cheng's room. For a moment, the green light in the room was slowly sucked into Yue Cheng's body.Then Yue Cheng exhaled a long breath, two rays of light flashed in his eyes, and his whole aura also underwent a subtle change in an instant.

"We have finally entered the early stage of foundation building." Yue Cheng murmured. After seven days of training, he finally successfully entered the early stage of foundation building. With super strong realm support, any training level is just a matter of time for Yue Cheng now.

"It's time to go out for a walk and see this strange world." Yue Cheng tidied up and got out of bed. He had not left the room for seven days. In the past few days, only Su Xin'er and Sister Feng had visited him and brought a lot of delicious food.

"Hello, young master." Yue Cheng walked out of the room. Some servants greeted Yue Cheng happily, and Yue Cheng also nodded slightly to everyone.

Although the Yue family has declined, it is still quite prestigious in Liying Town. The Yue family's mansion is located at the end of Liying Town. The entire Yue family now has thirty or forty people without servants. However, many members of the Yue family are not in the Yue family. Basically, the younger generation has gone out to make a living. For example, Yue Cheng's two brothers left the Yue family when they were fifteen years old. It has been seven or eight years now.

There is also an uncle and cousin of Yue Cheng in the Yue family, and the others are second-generation members of the Yue family. Most of the second-generation members of the Yue family like Yue Cheng are working outside, and the rest are helping to manage the Yue family's business.

Yue Cheng walked slowly in the Yue family's mansion. The Yue family's mansion looked quite decent. There were nearly a hundred rooms alone, plus the ancestral hall and other buildings. It took Yue Cheng a long time to walk through it.

"I have to go and see if I can find materials for refining elixirs and magical weapons here." Yue Cheng murmured in his heart. He didn't know if there were any materials for refining elixirs and magical weapons on Xuantian Continent. If not, it would be really troublesome, and his cultivation would be greatly reduced.

With this thought in his mind, Yue Cheng no longer hesitated, and quickly went to the Yue family's shops to have a look. In his memory, Yue Cheng learned that there seemed to be some shops in the Yue family that sold medicinal materials and weapons, and he didn't know if these materials were suitable for his own use.

"Cousin, where are you going?" As soon as Yue Cheng walked to the door of the Yue family's mansion, Su Xin'er's voice came from behind Yue Cheng, and she immediately walked in front of Yue Cheng.

Today, Su Xin'er is wearing a blue dress, with her black hair tied up in a high bun on the back of her head. She has big eyes and a small mouth, a pair of soft spots on her chest standing like mountains, a slender waist that is less than a handhold away, round and strong buttocks, and a pair of tall and slender legs, which makes her look very feminine.
